*** ALPHA SOFTWARE -- THE API IS NOT STABLE ***

        Pre-1.0 and under active development. Anything public may be added,
        renamed or removed in any release, breaking code that compiles today,
        with no deprecation period first. A 0.x version carries no
        compatibility promise and these are used that way: treat every bump
        as potentially breaking. Pin an exact version. Not recommended for
        production use.

        Java SDK for the Flexemarkets trading API.
